content.intro: This lesson covers Profiling CPU and Memory Usage. It sits in Module 23, Compiler, Build System, and Performance, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Profiling CPU and Memory Usage matters when you work with measured performance and resource use. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Performance work starts with a repeatable baseline. Measure representative workloads, identify the bottleneck, make one change, and benchmark again rather than assuming an optimization helps.

content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
